newsitem.title: TURKEY: Turk appliances firm in partial capital float.
newsitem.headline: Turk appliances firm in partial capital float.

text.p: Turkish electronic household appliances producer Ihlas Ev Aletleri Imalat Sanayi ve Ticaret A.S., owned by Ihlas Holding, offered part of its capital to public at a fixed price of 13,000 lira per each 1,000 lira nominal-valued share, manager banks said.
The two-day offer co-managed by Garanti Yatirim Bank and Egebank began on Thursday.
The company plans to sell 22.5 billion lira worth shares of its total 90 billion lira capital to public.
Ihlas Holding's 65.55 percent stake in Ihlas Ev Aletleri will go down to 40.55 percent after the offer.
Ihlas Ev Aletleri produces about 30 different types of electronic household appliances like heaters and water heaters, water purifying machines, kitchenware as well as hair dryers.
The company plans to start durables production in coming years.
Its net profit was 26.5 billion lira and net sales were 1.23 trillion lira in first half 1996, up sharply from 6.8 billion and 514.3 billion, respectively in the same 1995 period.
